name: Jude
description: Jude est un homme à la peau foncée, portant un chapeau de paille à ruban bleu marine, un costume beige clair, une chemise blanche et un gilet noir. Il a une barbe courte et soignée.
speechPersonality: La voix de Jude est calme et posée, avec une articulation claire et un ton confiant. Il s'exprime avec une certaine élégance, reflétant son apparence soignée. Le débit est modéré, permettant une bonne compréhension de chaque mot.

tonePrompts.neutral: A bust portrait of a man with dark skin, featuring an oval-shaped face and a neatly trimmed short beard and mustache. His dark brown eyes gaze directly forward, conveying a calm and composed demeanor, with subtle shadows beneath them. His eyebrows are dark, well-defined, and neatly groomed. His hair is very short and dark, visible at the temples and nape of the neck beneath his hat. He wears a light beige straw boater hat with a flat crown and brim, adorned with a dark navy blue ribbon band. His attire includes a crisp white collared dress shirt, unbuttoned at the top to reveal a thin, delicate gold chain around his neck. Over the shirt, he wears a black V-neck knitted vest. A light tan, double-breasted suit jacket with wide lapels is visible over the vest and shirt, adding a touch of classic elegance. The man's head is slightly tilted, and his expression is neutral yet engaging. The composition is a tight bust shot, ensuring his face and lips are prominent, large, and completely unobstructed, ideal for a talking video. The lighting is soft and even, originating from the front-right, casting gentle shadows that highlight his facial contours. The background is a plain, light grey, providing a clean and uncluttered setting for the portrait.
